results.query: Which loan products can I apply for and what makes me eligible for each?
results.answer: A Personal Loan needs the applicant to be between 23 and 58 years old with a verified monthly income of at least INR 25,000, while a Home Loan additionally requires a clear property title and a loan-to-value ratio at or below 80 percent. Personal Loans run from 11.5 percent for scores above 780, to 14.9 percent for scores between 700 and 779, to 18.5 percent below 700. Cred evaluates eligibility separately for each lending product rather than against a single cut-off. [source: KB-001, KB-007]

results.query: How does Cred work out the EMI on a sanctioned loan?
results.answer: Cred computes the equated monthly instalment using the standard reducing-balance formula EMI = P * r * (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1), where P is the sanctioned principal, r is the monthly interest rate, and n is the tenure in months. A Cred loan application moves through five states: Submitted, Under Review, Approved or Rejected, and finally Disbursed. [source: KB-002, KB-013]
